fields.description: Client-generated UUID. Deterministic naming keeps a re-applied vertical template idempotent (spec F3) and doubles as the offline upsert key.
fields.label: Table UID

fields.description: Text, not a number — "Barra 3" and "Terraza A" are real table names.
fields.label: Table Label

fields.description: Default cover count. There is no seat-level model.
fields.label: Seats

fields.description: Soft delete. A table stamped on a settled invoice is reporting history — never hard-delete it.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: Fast-repaint hint reconciled from the open-order count — NEVER the source of truth. Written only by reconcile_table_occupancy (api/restaurant/_tickets.py).
fields.label: Occupied

fields.description: Awaiting bussing. The one derived-looking state nothing in the ledger implies, so it is stored.
fields.label: Needs Cleaning

fields.description: Proforma handed to the table. Tracked here, never by overloading posa_is_printed — that flag is load-bearing for shift close (spec F2).
fields.label: Bill Printed At

fields.description: {"x": n, "y": n, "w": n, "h": n, "rotation": deg, "shape": "square|round", "color": "#rrggbb"} in GRID units against the floor's canvas frame — not bare pixels.
fields.label: Layout
